trial_court: Family Court, North District, Rohini Courts, Delhi in H.M.A No. 559870/2016
case_name: Examination Of Respondent. Ms. Neelu ... vs Mr. Prabhat Suri on 29 November, 2024
facts_of_case: The wife seeks maintenance under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court rejected her application. She is now bringing up two children single-handedly and the husband pays monthly maintenance of Rs.25,000.

legal_principles.principle: Subsequent events cannot be a ground to test an earlier order.
legal_principles.held: We are inclined to agree with him that subsequent documents sought to be relied upon by the appellant cannot be a ground to test the impugned order.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking to set aside an order must move a fresh application.
legal_principles.held: We, therefore, dispose of the appeal by granting the appellant liberty to move a fresh application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 before the learned Family Court.

outcome.final_order: The respondent will continue to pay maintenance @ Rs.25,000 till the decision by the learned Family Court on the fresh application to be filed by the appellant.

use_for_drafting: preparing for cross-examination in family court
